//: FILE: examples/new-job.json  -  a sample 'add a job' request
JSON files cannot contain normal comments, so explanations are stored
in extra entries whose names start with //. The server ignores them.
WHAT THIS FILE IS, IN PLAIN ENGLISH
A ready-made form for adding ONE new job opening. You send it to the
server with the POST /jobs request. It gets the next id (e.g. 7).
HOW TO USE IT (in a second terminal, while 'npm run dev' is running)
Then open http://localhost:3000/jobs/7/matches to see who fits it
best. Sherlock should be near the top (2 of the 3 skills, analytical).
To remove it again: npm run seed
// title: REQUIRED. The job title. Must not already exist.
title: Security Analyst
// min_experience: REQUIRED. Minimum years of experience, a whole number 0 or more.
// required_skills: REQUIRED. At least one skill. These are worth up to 60 of the 100 points when scoring candidates.
// culture_keywords: OPTIONAL. Personality words the team values. Worth up to 10 points when a candidate's traits match.
// tagline: OPTIONAL. A fun one-line description of the job.
